alt.en: A wide view of the European Parliament's semicircular chamber, its rows of blue desks filled with members voting, under a white ceiling, with the EU flag and national flags behind the presiding officers.
alt.zh: 欧洲议会半圆形会议厅的全景：一排排蓝色议席坐满正在表决的议员，上方是白色天花板，主席台后方挂着欧盟旗和各成员国国旗。

caption.en: Members of the European Parliament vote on amendments to the AI Act, then still a proposal, in Strasbourg on 14 June 2023. The photo does not show the vote of 16 June 2026 on the Digital Omnibus on AI.
caption.zh: 2023 年 6 月 14 日，欧洲议会议员在斯特拉斯堡就《人工智能法》修正案进行表决，该法当时仍是提案。照片中并非 2026 年 6 月 16 日对 Digital Omnibus on AI 的表决。
